name: EvidenceCheck
description: Evidence-first vendor due-diligence capabilities for AI agents and procurement, third-party risk, security and compliance workflows. The service turns public vendor signals and supplied business text into structured evidence, gaps and next-step questions.

capabilities.name: Webpage Extractor
capabilities.useWhen: A public webpage must be converted into clean text, metadata, headings and links.

capabilities.name: Website Security Preflight
capabilities.useWhen: A public website needs a fast first-pass security signal before deeper review.
capabilities.output: Observable headers, cookies, HTTPS and disclosure signals

capabilities.name: Vendor Security Preflight
capabilities.useWhen: When you need a fast public-evidence preflight before requesting deeper vendor review or human escalation.
capabilities.output: Observable controls with source/timestamp, discovered public evidence pages, coverage, gaps and targeted supplier questions

capabilities.name: Business Document Analyzer
capabilities.useWhen: Business-document text needs deterministic structured triage.
capabilities.output: Dates, amounts, obligations, security signals, gaps and risk flags

discovery.bazaar: Paid routes declare x402 Bazaar metadata for compatible facilitators/catalogs.
